name: A10-0197/2025 – Jörgen Warborn – Article 2 – § 1 – point 2 – point b – point i; Directive 2013/34/EU – Article 19 a – § 3 – sub§ 1 – Am 408
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
section: Article 2 – paragraph 1 – point 2 – point b – point i
part_text: ‘Where applicable, the information referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall contain information about the undertaking’s own operations and about its value chain, including its products and services, its business relationships and its supply chain.’;
